subject: Upgrade to Enterprise tier — Q1 expansion, 8 new seats
body:
Hello,

We're planning to expand our team in Q1 2025 and need to upgrade our current Professional plan (12 seats) to Enterprise (20 seats). We are also interested in the SSO/SAML integration and the dedicated account manager included in Enterprise.

A few questions before we commit:
1. Can the Enterprise tier be billed annually in EUR? We need to avoid monthly USD conversion.
2. Is there a volume discount for 20+ seats?
3. What is the onboarding timeline for SSO setup? Our IT team needs at least 2 weeks lead time.
4. Can you hold our current per-seat rate through the upgrade?

We would like to have this in place by January 6, 2025.

Kind regards,
Sophia Lindqvist
Head of Operations
notes: AE notified. Sophia open to a call next week.

subject: Data export for annual audit — FOIA compliance
body:
To Whom It May Concern,

Pursuant to our contractual data portability rights and applicable state public records requirements, the City Park District requests a full export of all data associated with account CPD-00421 for the period January 1, 2024 through November 30, 2024.

Required formats: CSV for tabular data, PDF for reports. Encryption required (AES-256, key to be shared via secure channel).

Deadline: December 6, 2024 (statutory audit requirement).

Please confirm receipt and estimated delivery. Direct any questions to our General Counsel at legal@cityparkdistrict.gov.

Derek Washington
Information Systems Manager
notes: Legal and engineering looped in. Export estimated 3–4 days. Acknowledged receipt 11/27.

subject: Feature request: bulk CSV import for student roster
body:
Hello Product Team,

Our organization manages 1,400 student accounts and onboarding them one-by-one is taking our admin team 3 full days every semester. We'd love to see a bulk CSV import feature.

Ideal workflow:
1. Download template CSV with required columns
2. Fill in student data
3. Upload → validate → confirm
4. Any errors shown inline with row numbers

This single feature would save us ~6 hours per semester and likely reduce our support tickets too. I know other nonprofits in our network have the same pain point.

Happy to participate in a beta or provide sample data.

Amanda Torres
Operations Manager
notes: Logged to product board. Sent standard feature request acknowledgement.

subject: GDPR Data Deletion Request — client Elaine Murray
body:
Dear Data Protection Officer,

I am writing on behalf of my client, Elaine Murray (account holder email: elaine.m.1981@gmail.com), to formally request erasure of all personal data under Article 17 of the GDPR ('Right to Erasure').

This request encompasses all data held in your systems, including but not limited to: account data, usage logs, payment history, and any third-party processors you share data with.

Please confirm:
1. Receipt of this request within 72 hours
2. Completion of erasure within 30 days
3. A written confirmation of deletion for our records

Failure to comply will result in a complaint to the relevant supervisory authority.

Yours faithfully,
Liam O'Brien, Solicitor
O'Brien Legal Associates
